name: io.github.cyanheads/eu-parliament-mcp-server
description: Track European Parliament procedures, MEPs, votes, documents, speeches, and questions.

tools.name: euparl_list_reference
tools.description: List parliamentary codes, identifier formats, historical committees and political groups, or coverage limitations. Topic organizations with organization_ids resolves the organization IDs other tools return, decimal (org/5154) or code (org/IMCO, org/S-D, org/ep-9), into published names and dates; a question's addressee_ids do not resolve here (COM is the Communist and Allies Group). Per-item found false means no detail was published, as for a code in the wrong case. Lookups page the supplied IDs; repeat the same ID list with page.next_offset. Committees and political groups keep historical coverage. No snapshots; missing end dates do not establish current status.

topic.description: Reference topic; organizations requires organization_ids, which other topics reject.

organization_ids.description: Organizations only (required, nonempty); order and duplicates kept, at most 20 looked up per page.

items.description: Decimal ID or case-sensitive code (IMCO, S-D, ep-9), bare, after org/, or in the https://data.europarl.europa.eu/org/ URI; labels such as S&D are rejected.

limit.description: Items per page; default 20. Local collections return every requested row, with no output-size cap. Caps: 1000 reference entries or 20 organization lookups; a larger limit narrows to the cap with a notice.

language.description: EU ISO 639-1 language, any case; default en; text is never translated.

tools.name: euparl_list_procedures
tools.description: List procedure references by procedure type; euparl_get_procedure reads a returned procedure_id for title, stage and participants. euparl_list_reference topic procedure_types lists process_type codes. There is no keyword, year, committee or stage filter. With process_type, every procedure of that type is listed in procedure_id order; continue with page.next_offset, passing page.snapshot to detect a changed set. Without it, only the first 10000 results are reachable and Parliament serves pages from two orderings, so pages can repeat or omit procedures; set process_type for a complete walk.

process_type.description: Procedure-type code from euparl_list_reference topic procedure_types, any case.

limit.description: Items per page; default 20. Local collections return every requested row, with no output-size cap. Caps: 1000 procedures; a larger limit narrows to the cap with a notice.

language.description: EU ISO 639-1 language, any case; default en; text is never translated.

snapshot.description: page.snapshot of a process_type listing; optional at every offset, fails snapshot_changed if the set changed; rejected without process_type.

tools.name: euparl_get_procedure
tools.description: Read a procedure: title, stage, events, participants or linked documents. Default section overview returns scalar fields and section counts; events, participants and documents page one collection. Continue with page.next_offset and snapshot; after snapshot_changed, restart at offset 0 without it. Participation groups stay historical. Missing detail returns found false; euparl_list_procedures discovers references. euparl_search_documents mode get reads linked documents; files are linked, not parsed.

procedure_id.description: Procedure YYYY-NNNN or YYYY/NNNN, optional letter suffix and (TYPE), eli/dl/proc/ prefix or public URI.

section.description: Default overview returns scalars and counts; a collection section pages its items.

limit.description: Items per page; default 20. Local collections return every requested row, with no output-size cap.

language.description: EU ISO 639-1 language, any case; default en; text is never translated.

snapshot.description: Returned collection snapshot; required above offset 0.

tools.name: euparl_search_documents
tools.description: Search adopted texts, committee documents, plenary documents, or MEP declarations on awareness of conflicts of interest (source mep_declarations); mode get with document_id returns any work's metadata and source-file links, not extracted text. Get takes document IDs from every tool, whatever the family; parent_document_ids lead from subdivisions to parent files, and adopted and based-on relations read with mode get, though a target can be unavailable upstream. Detail procedure_ids add the procedure an adopted text, plenary or committee document publishes on its family record; adopted and based-on relations never imply procedure links. Filters: text and sitting dates serve adopted_texts; title and related_process_id serve adopted_texts and mep_declarations; person_id and awareness_of_conflict serve mep_declarations; committee takes term but no year, plenary year but no term. euparl_list_reference topic document_types lists work_type codes. Adopted-text rows carry title, date and procedure_ids; declaration rows add what was declared, capacities and version links; committee and plenary rows carry identity only, so their title and date need mode get. Non-keyword adopted texts sort by document_id; keyword searches keep relevance order, and declaration searches past 100 matches read aligned 100-row pages; either can repeat or omit records across pages. Adopted texts and declarations reach the first 10000 results; continue with page.next_offset when present, otherwise narrow the filters.

mode.description: Default search; get requires document_id and takes no source or search filter.

source.description: Search only; default adopted_texts. mep_declarations lists MEP declarations on awareness of conflicts of interest.

document_id.description: Get only: a work ID from any tool, any family: canonical ID (TA-9-2024-0138), eli/dl/doc/ prefix or public URI in any case, or a returned citation (label, public_register_ref or decision label): T9-0138/2024, P9_TA(2024)0138, A9-0188/2023, P9_A(2023)0188, B9-0163/2024 (read as B-, else the QOB- question motion), RC-B9-0163/2024 or P9_OJQ(2024)03-13. Question citations belong to euparl_list_questions.

text.description: adopted_texts only: keyword search in the requested language.

title.description: adopted_texts and mep_declarations only: title search in the requested language. A declaration title names the member, capacity, committee and procedure.

year.description: Document year; adopted_texts, plenary and mep_declarations search.

term.description: Term 0–10; adopted_texts, committee and mep_declarations search, never with person_id.

work_type.description: Search only: family-specific code from euparl_list_reference topic document_types, any case.

sitting_date.description: adopted_texts only: sitting date YYYY-MM-DD, or range start with sitting_date_end.

sitting_date_end.description: adopted_texts only: inclusive range end YYYY-MM-DD; needs sitting_date and not before it.

related_process_id.description: Procedure reference YYYY-NNNN, YYYY/NNNN(TYPE), prefix or public URI; adopted_texts and mep_declarations search.

person_id.description: mep_declarations only: declarant person ID (124867), person/ prefix or public person URI; never with term.

awareness_of_conflict.description: mep_declarations only: true keeps declarations of awareness of a conflict of interest, false those declaring none.

limit.description: Items per page; default 20. Caps: 1000 documents, 100 adopted texts, 100 keyword adopted texts, or 100 MEP declarations; a larger limit narrows to the cap with a notice.

language.description: EU ISO 639-1 language, any case; default en; text is never translated.

tools.name: euparl_search_speeches
tools.description: Search term 9 or 10 speech activities (default 10), or read one with mode get and speech_id. Text and title search return metadata; include_text adds each speech's published text, speaker line and xml:lang tags, only in the selected language, at most 100 search rows per call. Every row lists original_languages. Follow document_ids with euparl_search_documents mode get, then parent_document_ids, to source files. euparl_list_reference topic activity_types lists activity_type codes. Non-keyword lists run in sitting-date order, at most 400 rows per call; keyword searches keep relevance order and can repeat or omit records across pages. Search reaches the first 10000 results; continue with page.next_offset when present, otherwise narrow the filters.

mode.description: Default search; get requires speech_id and takes no search filter.

speech_id.description: Get only: activity ID, eli/dl/event/ prefix or public URI.

text.description: Search only: keywords in speech text, in the selected language; include_text returns that text.

title.description: Search only: activity title keywords in the selected language.

person_id.description: Search only: numeric MEP ID, person/ prefix or public person URI.

activity_type.description: Search only: code from euparl_list_reference topic activity_types, any case.

sitting_date.description: Search only: sitting date YYYY-MM-DD, or range start with sitting_date_end.

sitting_date_end.description: Search only: inclusive range end YYYY-MM-DD; needs sitting_date and not before it.

include_text.description: Search and get; default false. True adds text, speaker and language_tags in the selected language, with no fallback: a speech unpublished in it omits title or text, with a notice; chair rows publish no title in any language and do not count as missing one. Search returns at most 100 rows.

limit.description: Items per page; default 20. Caps: 400 speeches, 1000 keyword speeches, or 100 speeches with text; a larger limit narrows to the cap with a notice.

language.description: EU ISO 639-1 language, any case; default en; text is never translated.

tools.name: euparl_search_meps
tools.description: Find MEPs by name, person ID, country, political group, gender, term or mandate date. Without term or mandate_date, members in office today; term selects that term's roster, mandate_date the members seated that day. Name matching needs every token, after case, diacritic and punctuation normalization, over the whole roster before paging. mep_ids takes the person IDs other tools return (voter mep_id, participant person_ids, question creator person/ references) in one call; IDs not in the roster come back in unmatched_mep_ids. Country and group are as published for the selected roster, never inferred for another date; term rosters publish neither. Continue with page.next_offset and snapshot; after snapshot_changed, restart at offset 0 without it. euparl_get_mep reads identity and membership history.

name_contains.description: Every token must match, over the whole roster; case, diacritics and punctuation normalized, no fuzzy scoring. Needs a letter or digit.

mep_ids.description: Person IDs to keep, as other tools return them: voter mep_id, participant person_ids, question creator person/ references. Canonicalized and deduplicated; an empty list counts as omitted; an org/ or other non-person entry is rejected. Narrows with every other filter, no extra request. Pick the roster the IDs belong to: mandate_date (the vote or sitting date) for country and group as published that day, term for names only.

term.description: Term 0–10, exclusive with mandate_date; omit both for members in office today.

mandate_date.description: Members seated on this YYYY-MM-DD date, not after today (UTC); exclusive with term. Country and group match as published that day. A term's first sitting day can return an incomplete roster or an upstream error; use the next day.

country.description: ISO alpha-2 code, any case. United Kingdom members are published as GB (UK accepted), on historical rosters only. See euparl_list_reference topic mep_filters.

political_group.description: Group code, current or historical (PPE, S-D, PPE-DE, GUE-NGL…), or published label (S&D, Verts/ALE, The Left), any case; EPP, Greens/EFA and Patriots also work. euparl_list_reference topic mep_filters lists codes, labels and periods. GUE/NGL is GUE-NGL on terms 0–8 and through 2020-12-18, else THE-LEFT. Current and mandate_date rosters match the code in force that day; a term roster matches memberships not ended when the term began, not who sat in the group during the term (use mandate_date).

gender.description: Gender code FEMALE, MALE, NAP, NKN or NST, any case.

limit.description: Items per page; default 20. Local collections return every requested row, with no output-size cap.

language.description: EU ISO 639-1 language, any case; default en; text is never translated.

snapshot.description: Returned roster snapshot; required above offset 0.

tools.name: euparl_get_mep
tools.description: Read an MEP identity or membership history: committee, delegation and political-group records. Default section overview returns identity, membership_count and membership_classifications (count per code); section memberships pages membership records, latest start_date first, filtered by classification and active_on before paging. Missing end dates do not establish current membership. Continue with page.next_offset and snapshot; after snapshot_changed, restart at offset 0 without it. Missing detail returns found false; euparl_search_meps discovers IDs.

mep_id.description: Decimal person ID, person/ prefix or https://data.europarl.europa.eu/person/ URI.

section.description: Default overview returns identity and counts; memberships pages the history.

classification.description: Memberships only: keep this membershipClassification code, bare (COMMITTEE_PARLIAMENTARY_STANDING) or as published (def/ep-entities/COMMITTEE_PARLIAMENTARY_STANDING), any case, matched on the last path segment. The overview lists the codes in membership_classifications; unclassified memberships never match.

active_on.description: Memberships only: keep memberships whose published interval includes this YYYY-MM-DD date, not after today (UTC), an absent end counting as open. A missing end date does not establish current membership.

limit.description: Items per page; default 20. Local collections return every requested row, with no output-size cap.

language.description: EU ISO 639-1 language, any case; default en; text is never translated.

snapshot.description: Returned membership snapshot; required above offset 0.

tools.name: euparl_get_plenary_votes
tools.description: Plenary sittings, agendas, votes and voters. Mode sittings lists a year's sittings. Mode agenda_items lists a sitting's published agenda, from the 2024-12-16 sitting on (and the weeks of 2023-07-10 and 2024-04-22): debate, vote and urgency-vote items in agenda order with type, title, heading, time slot, procedures and documents; it changes until the sitting, and a moved item changes ID. Mode vote_items lists a sitting's PLENARY_VOTE_RESULTS vote items with title, documents, procedures and decision_count (absent before 2024, whose vote items link no decisions); pass a vote_item_id to decisions. Default mode decisions pages compact decision summaries of sitting_id, filtered before paging by document_id (exact ID or hyphen-boundary descendant), vote_item_id (a vote_items row or a procedure's PLENARY_VOTE_RESULTS event) or label_contains. label_contains, in decisions or vote_items, matches a literal substring of decision labels (report citations, amendments) or vote item titles, ignoring case, repeated whitespace and dash style without altering published text or establishing a final vote; in a decision label a document_ids entry is cited with its prefix and term joined and the year after the number, so A-9-2022-0116 is A9-0116/2022 and the joint motion RC-9-2022-0257 is RC-B9-0257/2022. Mode decision returns one rich record with reference text and commentary; breakdown adds its recorded voters by political group and country from the sitting-date roster, values that go back to euparl_search_meps with that mandate_date. mep_id in decisions or decision returns recorded and intended positions; empty positions do not prove absence from the vote. Mode voters pages one position of decision_id; a missing array returns available false, a published empty one available true. resolve_names needs roster_term and joins names from that term roster only, never voting-date affiliations; some IDs stay unresolved. Continue with page.next_offset and snapshot; after snapshot_changed, restart at offset 0 without it.

mode.description: decisions (default) pages compact summaries; sittings lists a year's; agenda_items and vote_items list those of sitting_id; decision returns one rich record; voters pages one position.

document_id.description: Decisions only: canonical ID, eli/dl/doc/ prefix or public URI in any case, or a citation such as A9-0188/2023, P9_A(2023)0188, T9-0138/2024, B9-0163/2024 or RC-B9-0163/2024. Matches decided-on, part-of or recording relations by exact ID or hyphen-boundary descendant, before paging.

vote_item_id.description: Decisions only: MTG-PL-YYYY-MM-DD-VOT-ITM- ID, eli/dl/event/ prefix or public event URI, from a vote_items row, a vote_item_ids entry or a procedure's PLENARY_VOTE_RESULTS event. Selects every decision of that vote item; its date must match sitting_id.

mep_id.description: Decisions or decision: numeric person ID, person/ prefix or public person URI. Reads published arrays, no roster join; empty positions do not prove absence from the vote.

label_contains.description: Decisions or vote_items: literal substring of the selected-language label, ignoring case, repeated whitespace and dash style, before paging. Decision labels carry report citations and amendment numbers and combine with document_id and vote_item_id; in a decision label a document_ids entry is cited with its prefix and term joined and the year after the number, so A-9-2022-0116 is A9-0116/2022 and the joint motion RC-9-2022-0257 is RC-B9-0257/2022. Vote item labels are titles. A match does not establish a final vote.

sitting_id.description: Required outside sittings: YYYY-MM-DD, MTG-PL-YYYY-MM-DD, event prefix or public event URI.

decision_id.description: Decision and voters only (required): returned decision ID, eli/dl/event/ prefix or public event URI.

resolve_names.description: Voters only; default false. True joins names from the roster_term roster.

roster_term.description: Term 0–10 holding the sitting; required with resolve_names, else forbidden. Never inferred from dates.

breakdown.description: Decision mode only; default false. True adds breakdown: recorded favor, against and abstention voters tallied by the political group and country published for each on the sitting date (the euparl_search_meps roster for that mandate_date), one extra request. A decision that does not publish all three recorded voter arrays (a hand vote), whose arrays name no person, or an unreadable roster returns no breakdown, with a notice.

limit.description: Items per page; default 20. Local collections return every requested row, with no output-size cap. Caps: 1000 sittings; a larger limit narrows to the cap with a notice.

language.description: EU ISO 639-1 language, any case; default en; text is never translated.

snapshot.description: Snapshot returned by an agenda-item, vote-item, decisions or voters page; required above offset 0.

tools.name: euparl_list_questions
tools.description: List parliamentary questions by year and work_type, or read one with mode get and question_id: metadata, addressees, original languages, source-file links and published answers. Human citations such as E-000001/2025 keep their full year; without term, every overlapping term is checked and one verified match is required; canonical IDs resolve directly. euparl_list_reference topic question_types lists work_type codes. There is no keyword, author or addressee search. Empty answers means no answer relation was published, not that the question is unanswered.

mode.description: Default list; get requires question_id and takes no year or work_type.

work_type.description: List only: code from euparl_list_reference topic question_types, any case.

question_id.description: Get only: canonical E-{term}-{year}-{sequence}, document prefix or public URI, or a human E-sequence/YYYY citation; E/P/O/G/K prefixes in any case, sequences padded to six digits.

term.description: Get only: term 0–10 that disambiguates a human citation and agrees with a canonical ID; omit to check every term overlapping the citation year.

limit.description: Items per page; default 20. Caps: 1000 questions; a larger limit narrows to the cap with a notice.

language.description: EU ISO 639-1 language, any case; default en; text is never translated.
